stage: Pre-motion held-keyframe story reel. The renderer makes no video-generation requests, character animation, camera movement, crossfades or default zooms.
path_base: All input/output paths inside the config resolve from repository root; absolute paths also work. The config argument itself resolves from the calling directory.

timeline.accepted_containers: Inline list, repo-relative JSON path containing a list, or JSON object containing a timeline list.
timeline.ordering: Entries stay in supplied order. IDs must be unique. Frames are nonnegative integers; end_frame is exclusive. Start at zero, remain contiguous with no gaps or overlaps, end at ceil(decoded master seconds * 24).
timeline.image: Single still image readable by Pillow. EXIF orientation is applied. RGBA is composited over black. All images are decoded and checked before rendering starts.
timeline.crop: Optional static [x,y,width,height] in normalized source coordinates, each within source bounds. This is an explicit editorial crop only; absent crop preserves the entire source. The resulting source is uniformly fitted inside the canvas without cutting feet or stretching.
timeline.section_and_kind: Required labels retained for shot identity; they do not secretly enable effects.
timeline.extra_fields: Ignored; no automatic implementation of motion/effects fields.

lyrics.accepted_containers: Inline list, repo-relative JSON path containing a list, or JSON object containing a cues list.
lyrics.timing: Seconds from master WAV start. Input order must be chronological. Reject overlaps, empty/negative intervals and cues outside the master. Extra fields and top-level metadata are ignored.
lyrics.display_frames: Burned cues occupy [ceil(start*24), ceil(end*24)); a cue is never displayed before its supplied start. Intervals shorter than one display frame after quantization fail validation.
lyrics.layout: Heiti SC Medium, collection index 1, 38 pixels by default, warm white with restrained dark outline. Centered 72 pixels above bottom. Maximum width 1680 pixels; wrap up to two lines. Too much text or title collisions fail validation.

titles.accepted_container: Optional inline list; absent means no title overlays.
titles.timing: Zero-based end-exclusive frame intervals entirely inside the reel.
titles.layout: Screen-space type, maximum two lines. Top position starts at 96 pixels; center is centered vertically. Visible bounding boxes must not collide with active titles or lyrics.
titles.branding: Input data should use 第一天 and exact series branding AI SI - I. The renderer adds no on-picture story-reel watermark.

letterbox: Optional numeric image aperture aspect >= 16/9, e.g. 2.39. Full image is contained within that aperture and centered on the same 1920x1080 canvas. Default null preserves full 16:9 dance imagery.

audio.input: Existing uncompressed PCM WAV with exactly one audio stream. Duration comes from stream duration_ts and time_base, not the source MP3 packet estimate.
audio.processing: No gain, normalization, stretching, resampling, padding, cuts, fades or SFX are added. The master is encoded once to 320 kb/s AAC for MP4 delivery; the Chinese version copies that same audio stream. Master WAV remains untouched.
audio.end: Picture rounds up to one whole frame so no recording tail is intentionally cut. No -shortest muxing. A 40 ms picture tail is expected for this master.

outputs: <name>_clean.mp4: held images and supplied title overlays; optional switchable Chinese mov_text subtitle track, disabled by default.
<name>_zh.mp4: identical cut and audio, Chinese lyrics burned in; no duplicate subtitle track.
<name>.zh.srt: UTF-8 sidecar subtitles preserving source cue times to millisecond precision.
<name>.render_report.json: exact-frame conformance, source hashes, output paths and limitations.

implementation.dependencies: Repository Pillow environment, ffmpeg with libx264, ffprobe; no external subtitle filter is needed.
implementation.encoding: Compose each unique still/crop/active-text combination once. FFconcat image durations use exact frame counts at source framerate 24. A final sentinel closes the last hold; -frames:v excludes its frame. Encode each version once with libx264, then mux audio separately without truncation.
implementation.available_local_filters: Inspected 2026-10-02: installed ffmpeg lacks subtitles and drawtext; Pillow performs Chinese typography. The basic fps/setsar filters and concat image demuxing were verified with a six-frame, three-color probe.
implementation.failure_handling: All subprocess calls check exit status and surface stderr on failure. Inputs and text layout are validated before output encoding. Both video versions must pass decoded frame-count/geometry/rate and audio-duration checks before replacing exports.
implementation.cache: Intermediate composited PNGs and silent video are placed in a unique work-directory child and removed after success or failure. --keep-cache retains them for inspection.
implementation.quality_options: --preset fast and --crf 18 default; preset and CRF can be set explicitly. No automatic image grading or generation.
implementation.scope: The renderer cannot establish finished dance quality or musical synchronization by itself. Human playback remains required.

h3_dry_run_observation.effects: --dry-run creates h3_log and takes its local batch lock, requires FAL_KEY, reads relevant request logs, and calls the fal pricing GET endpoint. It makes no generation POST and returns before payload/media conversion.
h3_dry_run_observation.limit: It is not offline and does not validate all image/audio assets or full model payloads. Use separate local validation before a future authorized generation run.
